header.hint: A scan is already running for this AWS account.

card.heading: Region coverage

card.footerMulti: S3 and CloudFront are checked on every scan.

card.waitingDetails: Queued in this scan. Earlier results shown.
card.waitingNeverDetails: Queued in this scan. It hasn't been scanned before.
card.notScannedDetails: Not scanned yet. Resources here, other than S3 buckets, aren't in any count.
card.notEnabledDetails: Opt-in regions this account hasn't enabled. Nothing to scan.

card.footerOffNone: S3 and CloudFront are checked in every region on each scan.
card.formerHomeDetails: Not scanned since your home region moved. S3 buckets here are still checked on every scan.

reasonLines.access_denied: R couldn't be checked on the last scan (access denied).
reasonLines.access_denied_scp: R couldn't be checked on the last scan (blocked by a policy).
reasonLines.throttled: R couldn't be checked on the last scan (AWS was busy).
reasonLines.call_timeout: R couldn't be checked on the last scan (AWS didn't respond).

notes.access_denied: AWS refused our read role in R. Resources found there earlier stay listed until a complete scan.
notes.access_denied_scp: AWS denied access to R (an organization policy may block it). Resources found there earlier stay listed.
notes.throttled: AWS was busy and slowed our requests in R, so it couldn't be checked on the last scan. Try again with Scan now. The 31 resources found there earlier stay listed until a complete scan.
notes.throttledNoCount: AWS was busy and slowed our requests in R, so it couldn't be checked on the last scan. Try again with Scan now.
notes.call_timeout: AWS didn't respond in time in R. Try again with Scan now. Resources found there earlier stay listed.
notes.error: The scan ran into an error in R. Try again with Scan now. If it keeps happening, contact support.
notes.region_not_ready: R is enabled, but AWS isn't ready to answer there yet. The next scan tries again.
notes.region_deadline: R took longer than the time limit for one region, so it wasn't finished. The next scan tries again. Resources found there earlier stay listed.
notes.scan_budget: The scan reached its overall time limit before it got to R. The next scan tries again.

legend.complete: Complete: the last scan of this region finished with nothing missed
legend.partial: Partial: some resource types or listings were missed; see the details
legend.scanning: Scanning: a scan is running; counts may change when it finishes
legend.waiting: Waiting: queued in the running scan; earlier results shown
legend.couldnt: Couldn't check: the last scan couldn't check this region; results from an earlier scan stay listed
legend.notdone: Not ready / not reached / not finished: the last scan didn't check this region; the next scan tries again
legend.not_scanned: Not scanned yet: enabled in this account, not scanned yet
legend.no_longer: No longer scanned: your former home region; it isn't scanned while multi-region scanning is off
legend.not_enabled: Not enabled: an opt-in region this account hasn't enabled; nothing to scan
